newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures cut gains, still higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures cut gains, still higher.

text.p: April 17 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures cut their gains but were still higher. June S&P unable to test 2-week high set last week at 774.60, a level that had been many bulls' target, traders said. Nasdaq 100 futures remain strong, Nikkei 225 off slightly. KC Fed president Hoenig said nearly all sectors of economy were growing solidly.
